items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: I’ve seen Norris Turney in living, but I don’t think I could do that either.

ctx.x: someone would say, “That’s Norris Turney.” And another person, “Na man, that’s not Norris Turney.” So I wondered if you’ve ever participated —
I’ve seen Norris Turney in living, but I don’t think I could do that either.

It was such a wonderful thing because some of these people had played with him or, you know, “Oh man, I was in a bar with him, that’s not him.” And have you ever participated in an audio version of that?
